title: Romania extends pre-trial detention of far-right politician Calin Georgescu
description: The Bucharest court has extended the pre-trial detention of Calin Georgescu by 30 days, appealing a lower court ruling.

title: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare call with Putin
description: An end to the conflict in Ukraine "will not be achieved through silence," Finland's President Alexander Stubb said.

description: In his letter, the vice president suggested an immediate resumption of comprehensive talks, including about Iran’s nuclear program.

title: Gaza health officials say Israeli strikes kill 5
description: Israeli strikes in Gaza have reportedly killed five people and injured several others. The attack included a drone strike in Rafah, according to local sources.

title: Number of Ethiopians fleeing to Kenya jumps to 50,000 as clashes continue: UNHCR
description: GENEVA, Switzerland: Fighting in southern Ethiopia has caused some 50,000 to flee over the border to Kenya since clashes erupted last week, the United Nations said on Wednesday, citing local authorities. title: Italian PM slams ‘shameful’ release of alleged protest organizer
description: ROME: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni on Wednesday slammed a “shameful” decision by a judge dismissing accusations against a campaigner arrested on terrorism charges for allegedly seeking to organize violent protests. description: WASHINGTON: Republican President Donald Trump and Democratic former President Barack ​Obama head to Ohio and Georgia on Wednesday, the sites of critical contests in the November 3 midterm election that will determine which party controls the US Congress for the next two years. description: NEW YORK CITY: Attacks by the Yemen-based Houthis on airports and other civilian infrastructure in Saudi Arabia raise the question of possible war crimes, the UN’s top human rights official told Arab News, as he also condemned the detention of dozens of UN staff in Yemen by the Iran-backed militia. description: KHERSON, Ukraine: A planned six-day ceasefire brokered by US first lady Melania Trump and tied to a humanitarian aid mission in a Russian-occupied town has brought rare quiet to the Ukrainian-held city of Kherson across the water. title: Libya’s eastern administration bars entry to Iranians, Afghans
description: Libya’s eastern government has barred entry to nationals from Iran and Afghanistan at all entry points. This decision follows similar restrictions on nationals from four African countries.

title: Iran attack on base in Jordan damaged American military aircraft, US official says
description: Iranian strikes damaged one A-10 Thunderbolt II and eight F-15s this week on the Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan.

title: Ukraine contracting around 1,000 Patriot missiles from allies, defense chief says
description: Ukraine is contracting a supply of around 1,000 missiles for U.S.-designed Patriot air-defence systems.

title: US military needs ‘urgent revolutionary institutional change’ to prepare for modern war, Petraeus says
description: Ret. Army Gen. David Petraeus praised the Pentagon’s new Autonomous Warfare Command but said the U.S. must rapidly prepare for modern autonomous war.

title: Lockheed eyes fresh PAC-3 interceptor production options for Ukraine, Europe
description: “If we were to go forward with exploring any kind of production in Germany, we would likely do that with a company like Diehl,” a Lockheed executive said.

title: EU natural gas prices top €100 for first time since 2022
description: As winter approaches, the price of European natural gas topped €100 / megawatt hour, its highest level since 2022. The EU says it's not worried about supplies, although its storage facilities are only 72% full, but warns households of a 'difficult' season to come. title: Russia woos African leaders at Moscow summit
description: In tonight's edition, a summit with nearly two dozen African leaders opens in Moscow with the Kremlin describing their countries as natural allies against the West. Also, Nigerian investigators say that dozens of detained miners who died in a crowded jail cell screamed for help as jailors ignored their suffering. And ahead of the Youth Olympics in Senegal, Kenya's ramping up support of its women's sportspeople.

title: Historic gains for Arab-majority parties in Israeli election
description: Two Arab-majority parties are set to win a historic 19 seats in total, amid a record turnout at the polls in Israel on Tuesday. Voters from the community, descendants of Palestinians who stayed after Israel's creation and who make up around 20 percent of the population, have been enraged by the Netanyahu government's ultra-nationalist Jewish vision for the country and the Palestinian territories. FRANCE 24's Emerald Maxwell reports.

title: Amid uncertainty over EU aid, Vitalii Kim insists Ukraine has no choice but to fight for motherland
